title: Personalised Sweet 16 Birthday Rainbow Word Art Print – Number 16
body:
Sweet sixteen deserves more than a card. This personalised 16th birthday word art print turns the number 16 into a rainbow of their name, their friends and everything they love right now.

Personalised 16th birthday word art print in rainbow colours

Fill in two boxes: the name, which appears once nice and big, and your word list of 20 to 30 words separated by commas, such as school friends, favourite bands, nicknames, the dog's name, in-jokes from the group chat. We repeat your words in different sizes and fonts across the number 16, shading from red through orange, yellow, green and blue to purple, until it is full. The preview shows what you have typed next to the print photo.

Keep to single words or short phrases of three words at most, put a comma between each, and leave out emoji and accented letters. We print exactly what you type, so check the spelling once more.

Why you'll love it

  • A rainbow number 16 made only from words you choose, so no two prints are the same
  • The name stands out once, and your other words fill every gap in different sizes
  • Premium Display frames in black or silver: thick, chunky and very professional, not cheap thin frames
  • Four print-only sizes, from a shelf-sized A4 to a statement A1

Size & details

  • Design: a rainbow number 16, filled with your name and 20–30 words
  • Print only: A4 (210 x 297 mm), A3 (297 x 420 mm), A2 (420 x 594 mm) or A1 (594 x 841 mm)
  • Paper: A4 on 350gsm card, A3 on 170gsm gloss, A2 and A1 on 210gsm gloss
  • Framed: A4 (with a stand) or A3 (with a hanging clip) in a black or silver Premium Display frame

Delivery

Your personalised 16th birthday word art print is posted the next working day, or the same day if you order before 12pm, by Royal Mail.
